items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2026

venue.name: [Swiss Games Museum](https://museedujeu.ch/)
venue.details: On the ground floor, entrance through the court

items.information: Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année. Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup. Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes : 3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.** Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup. **Note aux débutants :** Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable. __________________________ Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2Njg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be50ae158823f554eaf24566a8f1a7aa4c6d9eb2/IMG_4169.png)

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of the **WCA African Championship for 2026**, but is being hosted 3 weeks before the main Championship in several separate countries and venues across the continent. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU0MTA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e29e3f5ea7fe3728a156b02818d2878a1ffc9ce/2026_African_Champs_Logo.png) Please note that only the **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** will be held - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or fewer (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. Please see [this section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) of the WCA Regulations for more information on Fewest Moves solving. There will be a short break inbetween attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. items.information: # [FR] Cette compétition est une compétition de résolution optimisée (FMC) et ne comporte pas d'épreuves de vitesse. Il est conseillé aux nouveaux participants au FMC de lire l'article E du règlement de la WCA. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- # [EN] This is a Fewest Moves Challenge (FMC) competition and does not feature speedsolving events. Competitors who are new to FMC are advised to read Article E of the WCA regulations. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMzAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--428789535e7c3039c185f53aeb1dafff592214a3/BCC%202026%20for%20Canva.ai%20(1800%20x%201800%20px)%20(1).png) ## CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Quiet Championship 2026! ### IMPORTANT NOTE 1: This competition is only hosting 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. For regular speedsolving events, please see [BC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026), or [other competitions in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA). ### IMPORTANT NOTE 2: If you are registered for the main BC Championship 2026, registration for this competition is FREE. In this case, please indicate in your registration comments that you are registered for both, and DO NOT pay the $20.00 registration fee. **Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70680-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70679-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips. --- To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png) **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. items.information: Herzlich Willkommen zur ersten Mental Breakdown Competition in Hannover. Wir freuen uns auf einen Tag voller geistiger Höchstleitungen mit euch. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Dieser Wettbewerb ist auf das Blindlösen von Zauberwürfeln und die Disziplin FMC (Lösen in möglichst wenig Zügen) fokussiert. Das "normale" Lösen mit offenen Augen wird bei diesem Wettkampf nicht angeboten. Bitte melde dich nur an, wenn du am Blindlösen und/oder in FMC teilnehmen möchtest. Ansonsten bist du natürlich gerne als Zuschauer willkommen. Welcome to the first Mental Breakdown Competition in Hanover. We look forward to a day full of mental feats with you. **Note for newcomers:** This competition focuses on blind solving of Rubik's cubes and the discipline FMC (solving in as few moves as possible). “Normal” solving with eyes open is not offered in this competition. Please only register if you want to participate in blind solving and/or FMC. Otherwise, you are of course welcome to attend as a spectator. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--24c971553ea864bd55df39455e153dcf0c619e1f/Mental.jpg)

items.name: FMC Canada 2026
items.information: ![(https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ## FMC Canada 2026 ### [EN] This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026#69669-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026#69669-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [**Cubing Contests**](https://cubingcontests.com). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the third edition of Örebro Side Events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This competition will also include Unofficial Events, rules and results can be found at **[Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com)**. Read more under the tab Unofficial Events. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Additional official events include **3×3, Megaminx, Skewb, 3x3 One-Handed (OH), 3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC), and 5×5 Blindfolded (5BLD)**. The competition will also include the unofficial event **3×3 Team Blindfolded**. Participation in unofficial events is entirely optional and will not affect official competition results. Additional unofficial events, including **1×3×3 Floppy Cube** and **Magic**, are **tentative** and may be added depending on schedule availability and logistical considerations. Please refer to the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026#72726-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for further details. All competitors and guests are encouraged to carefully review the information tabs on this page for details regarding the **competition schedule, event regulations, venue guidelines, and registration procedures**. Familiarizing yourself with this information will help ensure the competition runs smoothly and that all participants have an enjoyable experience. We look forward to seeing you at **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

items.name: PBQ in Tashkent 2026
items.information: This competition holds only "Please Be Quiet" events - 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiblind and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Challenge. As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise. Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

items.name: FMC Lovers Fürth 2026
items.information: **Willkommen bei den FMC Lovers Fürth 2026!** Am Valentinstag dreht sich in Fürth alles um FMC. Wir freuen uns auf einen tollen Wettbewerb und eine großartige Atmosphäre. Lasst uns gemeinsam die kürzesten Lösungen finden und den Tag voller Liebe und Leidenschaft für den Würfel genießen! ❤️ On Valentine’s Day, everything in Fürth is about FMC. We are looking forward to a great competition and a wonderful atmosphere. Let’s find the shortest solutions together and enjoy a day full of love and passion for the cube! ❤️ FMC Lovers Fürth 2026 is open to every citizen from every nation.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ1MDI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5a0c89ec891d8c94483daa9fc75d40d70c8e7a78/logocrazy2wca.png) Drodzy, ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na pierwszą imprezę nowego roku pod szyldem Cube Factory! Wracamy do szalonej konwencji, podnosimy limity i dajemy Wam spokojnie zdobyć oficjalne średnie w mniej popularnych konkurencjach! Zapraszamy! **WAŻNE** Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2 regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia. Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 28 - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Dear All, Cube Factory Team invites you to the first Cube Factory competition of the New Year! We're back to the crazy high cut-offs and limits so that you can achieve your dreamt-of average in some less popular events! See you there! **IMPORTANT** Due to the high cumulative limit for the 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded events, experienced competitors may begin their attempts later in the round. In such a case, pursuant to point 2u2 of the WCA regulations, the competitor's cumulative limit will be reduced by the time relative to how much they were late 3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 28.

items.name: Polish Sylwester Tour: FMC Poznań 2025
items.information: Witajcie zawodnicy na zawodach z cyklu Polish Sylwester Tour 2025! Ta edycja odbędzie się w Poznaniu. Macie okazję na ułożenie swoich trzech ostatnich prób FMa w roku 2025! **Pamiętajcie, że na tych zawodach nie odbywa się standardowe układanie kostki Rubika na czas. Konkurencja Fewest Moves polega na ułożeniu kostki Rubika w jak najmniejszej liczbie ruchów.** Bardzo prosimy o zapoznanie się z [regulaminem](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), a w szczególności z [artykułem E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#article-E-fewest-moves), który wyjaśnia zasady obowiązujące w konkurencji FMC. items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Esse ano, estamos testando pela primeira vez um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! This year, we are testing for the first time one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.name: Dreht's Eich in Ergolding 2025
items.information: **Richtigs Deitsch** Griaß eich mitanand! Seid's recht herzlich willkomm'n bei der **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – da urboarischen Cubing-Competition, wo ned bloß d'Würfel, sondern aa d’Hirnwindung'n auf Hochtour'n laffa! Ob 3x3, 3BLD oder 7x7 – bei uns werd g'dreht, dass da Gummi glüht! Ganz egal, ob's no Anfänger seids, olle erfahrene Speedcuber oder einfach nur zum Zuaschau'n kemmts: Packt's eich zamm, kemmts vorbei und zoagt's, wos in eich steckt – oder lehnt’s eich z'ruck, genießt's de Stimmung und lasst's eich a guade Brezn🥨 schmecka (De miasad's aba seiba kaffa). Mia gfrein uns narrisch auf eich, und denkts dro: **Dreht's eich, aber gscheid!** **English** Hello everyone! A warm welcome to **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – the ultimate Bavarian cubing competition, where not just the cubes, but also your brains will be spinning at full speed! Whether it's 3x3, 3BLD, or 7x7 – we’re turning so fast the rubber’s burning! No matter if you're a beginner, a seasoned speedcuber, or just here to watch: Grab your stuff, come on over, and show us what you've got – or just sit back, soak in the vibe, and enjoy a good pretzel🥨 (you'll have to buy that yourself though). We’re super excited to see you, and don’t forget: **Spin it, and do it right!**

At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2025 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers. items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events*** and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2025, but is being hosted in several separate venues across the nation. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. There will be a short break in between attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

Aquí no importa la velocidad, sino la estrategia. ¿Te atreves a resolver sin ver? ¿Podrás encontrar la solución en menos movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most mind-focused challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas III 2025 levels up with the introduction of Big Blind. Three attempts, full concentration, and now blindfolded solving. It’s not about speed — it’s about precision and planning. Can you solve without sight? Can you find the most efficient solution? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.information: **[Galo]** Enlist'ous **pour de ren** si qe v'étes un **nouvè coursou** ou ben un [**souétou de l'AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Aoterment d'aotr l'enlistement coûte 5 nuros. Merci de **ben lire les condicions d'enlistement, la [Faire ao qhessions](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) e les [ghides d'espliqes de l'AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Sonjéz etout d'ergarder den l'ongllet [Programe](#competition-schedule). --- **[Brezhoneg]** **Digoust** eo an enskrivadur evit ar **genstriverien nevez** hag [**izili an AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). A-hend-all e koust an enskrivadur 5€. Mar plij, **lennit aketus ar c'hondisionoù evit lakaat e anv, an [FAG](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) ha [teulioù kennel an AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Taolit ur sell d'an ivinell [Steuñvad](#competition-schedule) ivez. --- **[Français]** L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- **[English]** Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. --- **[Esperanto]** Registriĝi estas **senpaga** por la **novaj konkursantoj** kaj [**AFS-membroj**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), ne gravas kia civitaneco vi havas aŭ kie vi loĝas. Alie, registriĝi kostas 5 eŭroj. Bonvolu legi la **registriĝajn kondiĉojn, la [oftajn demandojn](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) kaj la [AFS-lernilojn](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) zorgeme**. Legu ankaŭ la langeton [Horplano](#competition-schedule).

items.information: ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Questa competizione si svolgerà a Monterotondo (RM) e San Gregorio di Catania (CT) in contemporanea. ​ I partecipanti *DEVONO* specificare la città in cui desiderano partecipare nei commenti al momento della registrazione. **L'UNICO** evento di questa competizione è il **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. I partecipanti dovranno essere seduti e pronti a cominciare i tentativi agli orari prestabiliti. **Il costo di registrazione per questa competizione è:** * €10 (Euro) per i soci di Cubing Italy (nota: associarsi è gratutito, maggiori informazioni sotto). * €20 (Euro) per i non soci di Cubing Italy (nota: i non soci dovranno pagare, oltre ai €10 online, €10 in loco nel caso decidessero di non associarsi). ___ ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) This competition will take place in Monterotondo (RM) and San Gregorio di Catania (CT) simultaneously. ​ Competitors *MUST* specify in the comments of the registration the city they wish to compete in. ​ Please note that the **ONLY** event at this competitions is **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. Competitors should be seated and ready to start the attempts at the scheduled start times. **The registration fee for this competition is:** * €10 (Euro) for Cubing Italy Cubing Italy Members (note: this membership is free, see more below). * €20 (Euro) for Cubing Italy non-members (note: non-members will have to pay €10 online plus €10 on site if they decide not to become Member).

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". items.name: FMC Tijuas II 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1bebd0144612f93a0dcf3a3fe3a47b3623ad1272/image.png) Llega de nuevo a Tijuana el desafío más cerebral del speedcubing. FMC Tijuas II 2025 sube de nivel con la incorporación de Big Blind. Tres intentos, concentración total y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no gana quien corre más, sino quien piensa mejor. ¿Estás listo para enfrentarte al cubo sin verlo? ¿Estás listo para resolver con el menor número de movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most cerebral challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas II 2025 takes it further with the addition of Big Blind. Three attempts, total focus, and now blindfolded solving. Victory doesn’t go to the fastest, but to the smartest. Are you ready to solve without seeing? Are you ready to move with precision? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.name: Cape Cubes Winter 2025
items.information: Welcome to Cape Cubes Winter 2025! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days, with a brand new format where we will do all the rounds of each event in a row, then move onto another event. Please look at the Schedule to see what this looks like, and when your events are due to begin. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. On-the-spot registration will be accepted, but it is still a good idea to register and pay online. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ​ **SPONSOR** A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Cubestuff shop at the competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwODIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f6279e9aecc7732beb40546a8e15830a644dfd6/cubestufflogocolourv2-2048x800.png) ​ **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--01c41a8280fe19ef88356bbc5b97d7c710f9edd2/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png)](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575052693279) ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est la résolution optimisée, qui nécessite une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent faire le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions au Québec et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ### Club de speedcubing de l'Université Laval Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### (EN) ### Please be quiet The main event in this competition is the Fewest Moves Challenge, which requires a great deal of learning, practice and concentration. All those present, including participants and guests, are asked to make no noise to enable the participants to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to participate in the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in Quebec and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### Speedcubing Club of Université Laval Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.information: This competition is part of the [CubingUSA New England Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewEnglandChampionship2025)! Podium winners and champions of each events will be recognized at the main competition, two weeks later in Portland. This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion. The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 Blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--fa4b5e2921088ef7a622e5262ede4bddbe4a5d51/NEC2025-Logo.png)

items.information: # This competition has been moved to Long Beach! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors are **expected** to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). This competition **WILL NOT** have most sighted events, such as 3x3x3 Cube. We recommend first-time competitors not register for this competition. For a more traditional competition experience, please check the [West Coast Cubing website](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) for a competition near you. **Current USC students can compete for free!** Please indicate so in the comment field during registration and send a photo of your student ID to the organization team to waive the registration fee. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by CubeSC, USC's Rubik's Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event! **Important!** In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

Será um prazer recebê-los. **VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH ### Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025! items.name: FMC Canada 2025
items.information: ![(https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ## FMC Canada 2025 ### [EN] This competition is **Canada's championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** as we will not hold the event at [Canadian Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). The top-three Canadian competitors will be recognized for the national podium. This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] Cette compétition est le **Championnat canadien de 3x3x3 résolution optimisée (ou FMC)** car nous n'organiserons pas cette épreuve lors du [Championnat Canadien 2025] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). Les trois premiers compétiteurs canadiens seront reconnus pour le podium national. Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#48026-faq) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025」のページです。 ・ [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open FMC WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWInter2025/)(**このページでは「FMC大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 9:10 定員56名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 13:00 定員56名 ・FMC大会：3x3x3 最小手数 1ラウンド、開場時刻 9:45 定員30名 ### 当日の来場時刻 AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:30の間にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の13:00までは会場に入れません。**必ず**13:00から13:20の間にお越しください。 FMC大会については、開場時刻の9:45までは会場に入れません。**必ず**9:45から10:15の間にお越しください。 AM大会は9:20から、PM大会は13:20から競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーを行います。スピードキュービングの競技やジャッジ、ランナーを初めてなされる方は競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーにご参加ください。 ※会場は他のイベントでも使用されている為、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。** ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 競技者以外のご入場 会場定員の都合上、入場者の数を制限させていただいています。 見学者（競技の観戦だけをされる方）の入場は会場定員の都合上、受け付けていません。 競技者が未成年者や身体的サポートが必要な方の場合、会場までの移動のサポート及び会場での安全の確保のため**保護者・サポート者の方1名**まで同伴していただくことは可能です。競技者が成人の方で身体的サポートの必要がない場合は、同伴者（ご友人など）のご入場はできません。 なお後日、当日スタッフを募集する可能性があります。当日スタッフとして登録されたかたはご入場していただくことは可能です。 ### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担 WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。 競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。 関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および 競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2) ★日本語が固まってから英語を修正 ### WCA Series Competitions Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in **only one** of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page is for Tokyo Opne FMC Winter 2025. [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "PM"**) [Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "FMC"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 56 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:00, limit of competitors 56 FMC：3x3x3 Fewest Moves 1 round, open at 9:45, limit of competitors 30 ### Arrival Information For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:10 and 9:30.** For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 13:00 and 13:20.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 13:00. For the FMC competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:45 and 10:15.** *Judge and runner lecture will be held at 9:20 for AM and 13:20 for PM. If this is your first time assigned as a judge or runner, please join the lecture session. *The hallway is shared with other events/business. Please do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. . ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at check-in. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Limit of non-competitor Guest We apply guest limitaion due to the venue capacity. We do not accept spectors. Underage competitors or those who has accessibility needs may **bring up to one non-competitor guest.** Adults and those who do not have accessibilty needs please refrain from bringing guests into the venue. We may request volunteer staffs for the competition in a later day. Those who are selected to be staffs will be accepted to enter the venue. ### The roles of judges and scramblers According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other roles required. For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

items.information: Wellington Mind Games 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3aa05b1024ee2e9271b7b0bd5d799771742bd090/IZCALLI%201%202%203%20(2).png) #### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico! Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!. Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). #### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament! There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli! We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição *não terá a modalidade* ***3x3x3*** ; - Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**; - O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event; - This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**; - The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **If the competitor limit of 28 isn't reached, we will be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$21, in order of arrival**

items.information: Varmt välkomna till Success For Candy Stockholm 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Notera dock att 3x3x3 inte kommer hållas på denna tävling. Eftersom DNF lär bli det vanligaste resultatet i tävlingens grenar kommer man få godis varje gång man får ett resultat som inte är DNF (och inte heller DNS)! Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Success For Candy Stockholm 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please note, however, that 3x3x3 will not be held at this competition. Since DNF will likely the most common result in most events of the competition, you will get candy every time you get a result that is not DNF (and not DNS either)! We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho II** é a segunda edição do nosso campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **07/12/2024**, ou até que o **limite de 70 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Fique atento aos horários de credenciamento na aba [Cronograma](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule). Chegue com antecedência para fazer seu credenciamento antes de qualquer modalidade que você for participar. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho II** is the second edition of our **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register) tab. * Registration closes on **12/07/2024**, or whenever the **limit of 70 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Pay attention to check-in times in the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule) tab. Please arrive early in order to check-in before participating in any event. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun! --- [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc1OTEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--930733faec45c31f0dd172905b90a8eceaa7b5f4/CUBOmenor.png)] (https://www.instagram.com/pevermelhocubo/) ### Realização: **Grupo Escoteiro Verde Vale - 3/PR** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdTlJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--16e16932678a6610581fca6a2b80723d8549fe13/gevv.png)](https://www.instagram.com/geverdevale/) ### Apoio: **Associação Guarda Mirim de Londrina** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak5JIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--570d92311785515d92cf46545f84e0c0ed16a933/image.png)](https://www.guardamirimlondrina.org.br/)

items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) **Adding/Dropping Events** - Competitors may request via the contact form to be added to more events BEFORE registration closes. - Competitors may not add events after registration closes. - Competitors may request via the contact form to remove events from their registration. It is also acceptable to not show up for any event you do not wish to compete in, although it is not encouraged. - Competitors may also adjust their registration details by themselves, without prior approval until the registration deadline If Registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In order to get on the waitlist, you must register and pay. You are not on the waitlist until you pay the registration fee. If you do not make it off of the waitlist, you will be fully refunded. If a competitor drops out, the first person on the waitlist will replace them. People can be replaced up until the registration close date indicated above. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

items.name: FMC Canada 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## FMC Canada 2024 ### [EN] [EN] This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] [FR] Cette compétition de 3x3 résolution optimisée aura lieu dans différents endroits simultanément à travers le Canada et aura un seul gagnant. Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024#45461-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024#45461-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador. ​ Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador. ​ The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2024
items.information: Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w bardziej popularnych konkurencjach, choć nie zabraknie side'owych akcentów. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/). Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz ze [Stowarzyszeniem Liga Niezwykłych](https://liganiezwyklych.pl/). Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/) oraz [Mazowsza](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). Marszałek województwa mazowieckiego [Adam Struzik](https://mazovia.pl/pl/bip/zarzad/sklad-zarzadu/adam-struzik.html) objął wydarzenie swoim patronatem. Na konkurencję **3x3x3 Najmniejsza liczba ruchów** obowiązuje oddzielny limit zawodników: **Najlepsze 30** osób według średniej (lub pojedynczego wyniku) na podstawie zawodników zarejestrowanych. --- We invite you to the fourth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in the more popular events, though there will be some side events as well. The event will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together. The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with the Stowarzyszenie Liga Niezwykłych. The event is funded by the City of Warsaw and Mazovia. The Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship, Adam Struzik, has taken the event under his patronage. For **FMC** event there is a seperate competitor limit: **Top 30** people classified by mean (otherwise single) according to the psych sheet of the registered competitors. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYwNDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c6e10f78d18761d23d665d7aa7448d5615b396be/unnamed.jpg)

items.name: Silence in Nayarit 2024

venue.name: [Universidad Autónoma de Nayarit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Q5aHgtajJXP3emD6)
venue.address: Ciudad de la Cultura "Amado Nervo" Tepic, Nayarit. México. C.P. 63000
venue.details: Aula Magna de la Unidad Académica de Educación y Humanidades

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWlFIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43e30f5cc65d1df2973f94fb32cb7e25100b1ee1/New%20Project%20(3)%20(2).png) ###### Español ¡**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! La primera competencia oficial en Nayarit especializada en eventos silenciosos se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 21 y domingo 22 de septiembre de 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en los eventos oficiales más difíciles. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos demuestren sus habilidades. La competencia incluirá una ronda de 3x3x3 Team-Blind, un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English **Silence in Nayarit 2024**! The first official competition in Nayarit specialized in silent events will be held in the city of Tepic on Saturday, September 21, and Sunday, September 22, 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in the most challenging official events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to demonstrate their abilities. The competition will include a 3x3x3 Team-Blind round, an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important that all competitors familiarize themselves with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2024
items.information: Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Tre försök av FMC kommer att hållas under morgonen fram till lunch, så om du inte deltar i FMC behöver du inte komma till lokalen förrens lunch. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on side events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Three attempts of FMC will be held during the morning up until lunch, so you don't have to come to the venue before lunch if you're not participating in FMC. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
